name: C11_SURVIVOR_PAIR_FAMILY_GATE_V1
fixed_context: One ordered type pair (T,T'), one stored 111 state (p,m,n), one post-Lemma10 descendant P'.

carrier.left: A={y in Y'(T) intersect N(Y0') : ym nonedge}
carrier.right: B={y' in Y'(T') intersect N(Y0') : y'm edge}
carrier.signature: Sigma(v)={C in cc(G[Y0']) : v complete to C}
carrier.relation: R_C11={(y,y') in A x B : yy' nonedge and Sigma(y) intersect Sigma(y') nonempty}

semantic_interface.pair_projection: Pi(y,y')={(gamma,delta) in {3,4}^2 : exists extension c of P' with c(y)=gamma,c(y')=delta}
semantic_interface.construction_rule: All structural classes, representatives and summaries must be computable from graph/frozen-state data without asking whether Pi is nonempty or what it contains.

target_question: How complicated can the exact bipartite survivor relation R_C11 be under the frozen P7-free C11 authority, and can its answer-relevant pairs be represented within the bounded-seed / n^{q(|S|)} architecture without pair-by-pair state growth?

P1_BOUNDED_PAIR_FAMILY.label: P1_BOUNDED_PAIR_FAMILY
pass_requires: |R_C11| <= g(|S|) for a proved function g independent of n, or a graph-only canonical superset R* with that bound containing every answer-relevant pair.
The bound follows from frozen hypotheses; finite experiments alone do not establish P1.
P1_BOUNDED_PAIR_FAMILY.implication_ceiling: Direct bounded pair absorption becomes plausible; no repair authorized.

P2_BOUNDED_VERTEX_HITTING.label: P2_BOUNDED_VERTEX_HITTING
pass_requires: Graph-only U subset A and W subset B with |U|+|W| <= g(|S|).
Every answer-relevant pair is incident with U union W.
The hit relation and construction are explicit and do not query extension existence.
The proof states exactly what pair semantics are preserved by hitting; arbitrary vertex cover of structural R_C11 is insufficient unless it covers all answer-relevant pairs by frozen reasoning.
P2_BOUNDED_VERTEX_HITTING.implication_ceiling: Bounded representative/absorption repair becomes plausible; no repair authorized.

P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT.label: P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT
pass_requires: A graph/state-only equivalence or factor representation identifies multiple distinct ordered pairs.
Classes/summaries are polynomially discoverable without extension oracle.
Each class summary preserves Pi(y,y') exactly for every member, or provides an exact frozen-boundary semantic object from which the members' Pi values are recovered without pair-specific storage.
The number/description of summaries respects the frozen polynomial budget.
The representation removes genuine pair-specific structural information.
anti_cheat: Identity classes {(y,y')} do NOT count as a quotient.
The trivial bound |R_C11|<=n^2 does NOT establish P3.
Grouping solely by equal Sigma signatures does NOT establish P3 unless exact Pi preservation/equivalence is proved.
A polynomial list of all pairs is not by itself a semantic quotient.
P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT.implication_ceiling: Pair quotient repair becomes plausible; no repair authorized.

P4_PAIR_STRUCTURE_UNRESOLVED.label: P4_PAIR_STRUCTURE_UNRESOLVED
P4_PAIR_STRUCTURE_UNRESOLVED.condition: None of P1,P2,P3 is proved from frozen authority.
P4_PAIR_STRUCTURE_UNRESOLVED.implication_ceiling: STOP. No hardness, lower-bound, impossibility, or exponential-family conclusion.

outcome_precedence: If P1 is not established, record NOT_ESTABLISHED rather than P1_FALSE.
If P2 is not established, record NOT_ESTABLISHED rather than P2_FALSE.
Audit P3 exact nontrivial quotient/factorization obligation.
If P3 is not established, record P4_PAIR_STRUCTURE_UNRESOLVED.
No repair follows automatically from any outcome.
structural_properties_to_audit: row and column neighborhood inclusion / nestedness
bounded biclique cover or rectangle representation
modules / true or false twin classes on A or B
factorization through Y0' component signatures Sigma
interaction of nonedge condition yy' with shared-component incidence
whether P7-freeness couples multiple rows/columns strongly enough to force bounded representatives

machine_search_interface.allowed_role: falsify candidate structural theorems, discover conjectures, or provide finite controls
machine_search_interface.forbidden_role: finite search cannot promote P1/P2/P3 without proof-carrying general justification

source_001_firewall.requirement: Any path depending on disputed 001 semantics is excluded from the authoritative C11-111 pair gate.

forbidden: return to H8 triple as primary carrier
reintroduce z identity into semantic state
next_action: Only a separately authorized structural audit of R_C11 may execute this gate. No repair is auto-authorized.
